verdict.rationale: PostHog's self-driving feature runs an autonomous background loop (scouts detect signals, an agent investigates, drafts fixes, opens PRs) that operates continuously without user prompting, and Workflows lets users configure no-code automations triggered by product behavior that run unattended. This is corroborated by dogfooding evidence (90+ scouts monitoring posthog.com) and a live public skills.zip release. Missing for 10: independent/third-party validation of the self-driving loop's real-world reliability and no community hands-on reports confirming autonomous runs succeed without heavy supervision.
